# WavWiz

> Free, MIT-licensed multi-zone music system built around Windows. Optional Linux/Docker server (amd64 only). No cloud account, no telemetry. Public beta.

Current public beta: **0.6.8**, released 10 November 2026. Windows installer: `WavWiz-Setup-0.6.8.exe`. Docker image tags `0.6.8` and `latest` are `linux/amd64` only; ARM64 / Raspberry Pi is planned for 0.7.0 and is not available yet. Chromecast is also planned for 0.7.0.

WavWiz runs a server on an always-on Windows PC (or in Docker on a 64-bit Intel/AMD Linux host) and plays through Windows WavWiz Players or any modern browser on phones, tablets, Macs and Linux PCs. Zones play different music or link for sync, with per-speaker delay, volume and EQ. Sources: local folders, NAS shares, internet radio, Subsonic/Navidrome. AirPlay in from iPhone, iPad and Mac; AirPlay 1 speaker output; AirPlay 2 output is experimental and off by default. HomePod and Apple TV are unsupported. AirPlay 1 password speakers, FairPlay, and AirPlay 2 PIN devices are not covered. The Docker image is server-only (no local speakers, no AirPlay 2 output); ARM64 / Raspberry Pi is not available yet. Home Assistant control is via REST plus an optional custom component (not on HACS). Spotify Connect is unofficial, off by default, and needs Premium. AI coding agents wrote the code; the developer designs and tests.
